integrity: Finite computations checked by two standalone exact enumerators and the published rank-five cycle theorem supplies the separate infinite argument. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to cycle squares with order at least five, pure first-order equality and adjacency, and quantifier rank four. The finite boundary requires the packaged exhaustive recurrence and is not proved by the cited cycle theorem alone; that theorem proves the unbounded tail via a one-quantifier interpretation. Higher rank, arbitrary cycle powers and historical priority are unresolved.
title: Fifteen four-round theories of cycle-square graphs
